title: Renew a motor dealer licence
summary: You can renew your motor dealer licence online if you have received a renewal notice.
intro:
If you’ve received your renewal notice, you can renew your motor dealer licence online.

You cannot conduct business if your licence is expired.

If you miss the renewal deadline and it's within 3 months of the expiry date you can restore your licence.

To find your motor dealer licence number and details, visit Verify NSW.
who_can_apply: You must have received a renewal notice to renew your motor dealer licence online.
what_you_need: Your renewal number (as shown on your renewal notice), or your name, birth date and postcode

how_to_steps.text: Follow the prompts to renew your licence.

faqs.q: What happens if my licence is expired?
faqs.a: You cannot conduct business if your licence is expired.

faqs.q: What should I do if I miss the renewal deadline?
faqs.a: If you miss the renewal deadline, you can restore your licence if it is within 3 months of the expiry date.

faqs.q: How do I find my motor dealer licence number and details?
faqs.a: Visit Verify NSW to find your motor dealer licence number and details.
